property_summary: On a fresh C, burn always reverts because the caller is not an allowed burning address, and allowedBurningAddresses is false for every address.

After an admin creates a game item with a non-empty token URI, the item's token URI is returned by uri(), uniqueTokensOutstanding() increases by one, and remainingSupply() equals the configured itemsRemaining.
A freshly created game item can never be transferred by a caller who is neither its owner nor approved, regardless of its transferability flag.
setApprovalForAll always reverts when the caller tries to approve themselves as operator, regardless of the requested flag.
For any token id, since no admin URI was ever set on a fresh contract, uri() always returns the base URI 'https://ipfs.io/ipfs/'.
